title: Cuebert asset manifest
description: Per-game-project declaration of ComfyUI-generated 2D raster assets, workflow bindings, and destination paths. Version 1 (M4-P2). Breaking changes bump the top-level integer version and this $id suffix.

^x_.description: Opaque project-defined extension namespace; ignored by core validators except for informational findings.

version.description: Manifest format version. Must be 1 for this schema. Future major bumps are breaking.

project.description: Workspace project key; MUST match a key under .cuebert/workspace-manifest.json projects.

engine.description: Target game engine for path conventions and future M4+ tooling.

defaults.description: Optional defaults merged or inherited by each asset entry.

workflow.description: Default ComfyUI workflow name (JSON stem under comfyui-toolkit/workflows/).

params.description: Base generation parameters shallow-merged with per-asset params (per-asset wins).

destination_root.description: Project-relative directory prefix (trailing slash) for advisory destination containment checks.

assets.description: Ordered list of declared generated assets; batching is expressed as multiple entries, not batch fields.

id.description: Stable unique id within this manifest: lowercase letters, digits, underscore, hyphen; max 64 chars.

prompt.description: Primary positive prompt; non-empty; max 4096 chars (ComfyUI toolkit cap).

seed.description: Optional RNG seed for reproducibility; omission means non-deterministic regeneration.

params.description: Per-asset parameter overrides merged over defaults.params.

destination.description: Project-relative output path ending in .png or .exr (HDR); no absolute paths; traversal sequences rejected.

tags.description: Optional flat string tags for filtering and reports.

references.description: Optional reference images used as pose/style/context (paths are project-relative).

path.description: Project-relative path to a reference file.
